note: Washington County KS parcels are not published as a public queryable service. The Kansas ORKA status layer lists Washington County as 'ORKA Private' (ORKA_LINK https://www.kansasgis.org/orka/intro.cfm?countyName=Washington). ORKA parcel access requires registration and per-county approval, and the county's own parcel search (washington.kansasgov.com/parcel) is a login gate. ORKA KS_ORKA_Extras has no county parcel layer. Commercial vendors (Regrid, DynaMo, Equator) sell the data; the Regrid nationwide tile service exposes no public query endpoint (404). Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online, ORKA services directory, county open-data and appraiser pages; none expose a public parcel service.
